verses.text: Do you indeed speak righteousness, silent ones? Do you judge blamelessly, you sons of men?
lines: Do you indeed speak righteousness, silent ones?
Do you judge blamelessly, you sons of men?

verses.text: No, in your heart you plot injustice. You measure out the violence of your hands in the earth.
lines: No, in your heart you plot injustice.
You measure out the violence of your hands in the earth.

verses.text: The wicked go astray from the womb. They are wayward as soon as they are born, speaking lies.
lines: The wicked go astray from the womb.
They are wayward as soon as they are born, speaking lies.

verses.text: Their poison is like the poison of a snake, like a deaf cobra that stops its ear,
lines: Their poison is like the poison of a snake,
like a deaf cobra that stops its ear,

verses.text: which doesn’t listen to the voice of charmers, no matter how skillful the charmer may be.
lines: which doesn’t listen to the voice of charmers,
no matter how skillful the charmer may be.

verses.text: Break their teeth, God, in their mouth. Break out the great teeth of the young lions, Yahweh.
lines: Break their teeth, God, in their mouth.
Break out the great teeth of the young lions, Yahweh.

verses.text: Let them vanish like water that flows away. When they draw the bow, let their arrows be made blunt.
lines: Let them vanish like water that flows away.
When they draw the bow, let their arrows be made blunt.

verses.text: Let them be like a snail which melts and passes away, like the stillborn child, who has not seen the sun.
lines: Let them be like a snail which melts and passes away,
like the stillborn child, who has not seen the sun.

verses.text: Before your pots can feel the heat of the thorns, he will sweep away the green and the burning alike.
lines: Before your pots can feel the heat of the thorns,
he will sweep away the green and the burning alike.

verses.text: The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance. He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked,
lines: The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance.
He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked,

verses.text: so that men shall say, “Most certainly there is a reward for the righteous. Most certainly there is a God who judges the earth.”
lines: so that men shall say, “Most certainly there is a reward for the righteous.
Most certainly there is a God who judges the earth.”
